c2_bad.why: Still the only core record and still the wrong one for a members page: only its seat-management clause (name/role/status/last active table, keyboard row actions, confirm dialog returning focus) applies; plan radio cards, invoice history, tabular prices and 'bulk selection state' are off-task. comp-settings-screen is again omitted as 'same category as a core pick', so the better-matched record loses to this one.

Selected 'for required coverage: visible focus', which it barely carries. Skip links and landmarks are an app-shell concern already owned by app-shell.tsx; adding one settings sub-page does not raise it. It displaced a11y-focus-visible, which c1 delivered and the implementation actually used (2px ring, destructive ring on invalid).

c2_direction_unjustified.why: 'sharp' contradicts the codebase: --radius is 0.5rem and shadcn panels/inputs are rounded; inspect itself reports radius=small.
